## Problem
Customers see error messages that falsely suggest a Keelwater system bug when the real issue is their own network failure. This creates unnecessary confusion and diverts attention from the actual root cause.

## Who is affected
- Two accounts have reported this issue via support tickets [i:12562525e3b8565d][i:64074f6fe85adcfb].
- The affected accounts include Marrowgate Commercial, which states the error message makes it sound like a bug when the issue is a customer network failure [i:12562525e3b8565d].
- The affected accounts also include Ormsgill Cyber, which apologized for a false alarm after investigating a customer network failure [i:64074f6fe85adcfb].

## Evidence
- There are 2 accounts and 2 mentions of this problem [i:12562525e3b8565d][i:64074f6fe85adcfb].
- All 2 mentions came through a single route: support [i:12562525e3b8565d][i:64074f6fe85adcfb].
- The total Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) from the two affected accounts is £1,735,000.0 [i:12562525e3b8565d][i:64074f6fe85adcfb].
- One of the affected accounts, Marrowgate Commercial, has an ARR of £1,600,000.0 and a renewal date of 2026-12-12 [i:12562525e3b8565d].
- The other affected account, Ormsgill Cyber, has an ARR of £135,000.0 [i:64074f6fe85adcfb].
- One account has renewed in the last 90 days [i:12562525e3b8565d][i:64074f6fe85adcfb].
- A user from Marrowgate Commercial said, "I’ve ruled out our own systems — it’s definitely a customer network failure, not Keelwater being down, though the error message makes it sound like a bug." [i:12562525e3b8565d]
- A user from Ormsgill Cyber said, "That’s what I suspected — our IT team is looking into the customer network failure now. Sorry for the false alarm." [i:64074f6fe85adcfb]

## Why now
The issue has been reported recently, with support tickets logged on 2026-09-14 and 2026-10-27 [i:64074f6fe85adcfb][i:12562525e3b8565d]. With one major account, Marrowgate Commercial, renewing on 2026-12-12, clarity in error messaging is important to maintain trust and avoid unnecessary support overhead before renewal [i:12562525e3b8565d].
</previous_draft>
